From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Redwood integration — SDK, auth, embeddings & prompt governance

Thanks for the invite — looking forward to the tech sync on Tue. A few quick notes / answers ahead of the call to help frame the discussion: 

1) SDK setup
- We provide official SDKs for Python and Node with examples for streaming, tool calling, and embeddings. Java is community-supported; we can provide a java-starter.
- Quickstart attachments include sample env vars and an auth example (API key vs short-lived token via STS).

2) Auth & network
- SAML SSO: Redwood supports SAML for web console and we can integrate SAML-backed provisioning for service principals via SCIM.
- Customer-managed KMS: we support envelope encryption; the control plane can be configured to reference a key ARN in your AWS account.
- Networking: we support VPC peering + allowlist egress IPs; for on-prem we offer a private deployment package.

3) Routing & model fallbacks
- Routing policy examples: latency-first (route to low-latency deduped variant), cost-first (route to quantized variant), region-first (routing by geofence).
- Automatic fallback: if a requested model is unavailable we can route to a compatible lower-capacity variant and log the event for compliance.

4) Embeddings & reranker
- We accept dense vectors (float32/float16) and provide a small client-side library to normalize vectors for common stores (Pinecone, Milvus, vectorDB).
- Reranking: we provide a hosted reranker endpoint; options: server-side reranking (returns top-k after model scoring) or client-side scoring (we return raw similarity + model-score metadata).

5) Structured output & tool calling
- We support function/tool calling with explicit JSON schema validation. Each schema is versioned; system prompts are anchored to a schema version to ensure compatibility.
- For prompt governance: we emit a tamper-evident audit trail for system prompts (who changed what and when). We also support prompt-signing for private deployments.

Pre-call asks: please share your Pinecone project id and an example query volume (avg qps and peak qps) so we can size batch/throughput recommendations.

I'll attach a short sample that shows a versioned prompt + schema mapping and a simple reranker config.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
